function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {
    setTimeout(initAllAccordionImageSync, 100);
  });
});</script>

function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {
    setTimeout(initAllAccordionImageSync, 100);
  });
});</script>

			  $(document).click(function(event) {

    $(".de-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: none;");
} else {
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
}
	
// Event handler for clicking the "select" button
$('.dropdown-lang + button').click(function(){
        localStorage.setItem('langSelected', 'true');
        localStorage.setItem('langSelectedTimestamp', Date.now());
        
});


var isSelected = localStorage.getItem('langSelected');
var storedTimestamp = localStorage.getItem('langSelectedTimestamp');
var currentTimestamp = Date.now();

if (isSelected && $('.elementor-editor-active').length == 0 && currentTimestamp - storedTimestamp > 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
        localStorage.removeItem('langSelected');
        localStorage.removeItem('langSelectedTimestamp');
    }
    
if (isSelected && $('.elementor-editor-active').length == 0) {
        langPopUp.remove();
}

	
});

function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {

});</script>

            overflow: hidden;

            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;

        .aqara-video-showroom .aqara-hotspots-layer {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in-out;
            z-index: 10;

            pointer-events: auto;
            opacity: 1;

        .aqara-video-showroom .aqara-hotspot {

            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

            padding: 15px; /* 增加热区，使 hover 触发更加灵敏轻松 */
            cursor: pointer;
            text-decoration: none;

        .aqara-video-showroom .aqara-hotspot-dot {

                    image: "https://www.aqara.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Mask-group-26.png",
                    url: "https://www.aqara.com/en/product/presence-switch-h2-us/"
                }
            ]
        };

        // --- 2. 核心逻辑（使用立即执行函数进行作用域限制，防止与其它小组件冲突） ---
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
            const contentArea = document.getElementById('content-area');
            const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.aqara-home-tab-card .tab-btn');

            if (!contentArea) return;

            function renderProducts(categoryKey) {
                const products = productData[categoryKey];
                contentArea.innerHTML = '';

                products.forEach((item, index) => {
                    const titleId = `${categoryKey}-product-${index + 1}-title`;
                    const cardHtml = `
                        <article class="product-card" aria-labelledby="${titleId}">
                            <a href="${item.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="card-image-wrapper">
                                <img decoding="async" src="${item.image}" alt="${item.title}">
                            </a>
                            <h3 id="${titleId}" class="card-title">${item.title}</h3>
                            <p class="card-desc">${item.desc}</p>
                            <a href="${item.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="learn-more-btn"
                                aria-label="Learn more about ${item.title}">Learn more</a>
                        </article>
                    `;
                    contentArea.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', cardHtml);
                });
            }

            function activateTab(tab) {
                tabBtns.forEach(btn => {
                    const selected = btn === tab;
                    btn.classList.toggle('active', selected);
                    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
                    btn.setAttribute('tabindex', selected ? '0' : '-1');
                });
                contentArea.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', tab.id);
                renderProducts(tab.getAttribute('data-target'));
            }

            // 原生 button 支持 Enter/Space；Tab 组件额外支持方向键、Home 和 End。
            tabBtns.forEach((btn, index) => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(btn));
                btn.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
                    let nextIndex = index;
                    const isRtl = getComputedStyle(btn.parentElement).direction === 'rtl';
                    if (event.key === 'Home') nextIndex = 0;
                    else if (event.key === 'End') nextIndex = tabBtns.length - 1;
                    else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') nextIndex = index + (isRtl ? -1 : 1);
                    else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') nextIndex = index + (isRtl ? 1 : -1);
                    else return;

                    event.preventDefault();
                    const nextTab = tabBtns[(nextIndex + tabBtns.length) % tabBtns.length];
                    tabBtns.forEach(tab => tab.setAttribute('tabindex', tab === nextTab ? '0' : '-1'));
                    nextTab.focus();
                });
            });

            // --- 3. 初始化 ---
            renderProducts('featured');
        });
    })();
</script>

	jQuery(document).ready(function($){
		
                $('.dropdown-lang').each(function() {
                    var $dropdown = $(this);
                    var defaultLabel = $dropdown.find('ul li[selected]');
                    if (defaultLabel.length) {
                        var defaultValue = defaultLabel.attr('data-value');
                        var defaultText = defaultLabel.text();
                        $dropdown.find('label').attr('data-value', defaultValue).text(defaultText);
                    }
                });

			  // Dropdown toggle
			  $('.dropdown-lang label').click(function() {
				$('.dropdown-lang ul').toggle();
			  });

			  // Set selected value and close dropdown on option click
			  $('.dropdown-lang ul li').click(function() {
				$('.dropdown-lang ul li').removeAttr('selected');
				$(this).attr('selected', 'selected');

				var selectedValue = $(this).attr('data-value');
				var selectedText = $(this).text();

				$('.dropdown-lang label').attr('data-value', selectedValue).text(selectedText);
				$('.dropdown-lang ul').hide();
			  });

			  // Close dropdown on outside click
			  $(document).click(function(event) {
				if (!$(event.target).closest('.dropdown-lang').length) {
				  $('.dropdown-lang ul').hide();
				}
			  });
			  
        	
        	
		
	});
	
</script>

    jQuery(document).ready(function($){

    $(".kr-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: none;");

    $(".jp-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: none;");
} else if (htmlLanguage == 'de-DE') {
    $(".de-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: none;");
} else {
    $(".global-lang-popup_description").attr("style","display: block;");
}
	
// Event handler for clicking the "select" button
$('.dropdown-lang + button').click(function(){
        localStorage.setItem('langSelected', 'true');
        localStorage.setItem('langSelectedTimestamp', Date.now());
        
});


var isSelected = localStorage.getItem('langSelected');
var storedTimestamp = localStorage.getItem('langSelectedTimestamp');
var currentTimestamp = Date.now();

if (isSelected && $('.elementor-editor-active').length == 0 && currentTimestamp - storedTimestamp > 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {
        localStorage.removeItem('langSelected');
        localStorage.removeItem('langSelectedTimestamp');
    }
    
if (isSelected && $('.elementor-editor-active').length == 0) {
        langPopUp.remove();
}

	
});

function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {

});</script>

function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {
    setTimeout(initAllAccordionImageSync, 100);
  });
});</script>

function initAllAccordionImageSync() {
  jQuery('.door-accordion-wrapper').each(function () {
    const $wrapper = jQuery(this);
    const accordionId = $wrapper.data('accordion-id');
    const imageId = $wrapper.data('image-id');
    let imageUrls = [];

    try {
      imageUrls = JSON.parse($wrapper.attr('data-images') || '[]');
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Invalid image list for', accordionId);
      return;
    }

    const $accordion = jQuery(accordionId);
    const $headers = $accordion.find('.eael-accordion-header');
    const $img = jQuery(imageId).find('img');

    // 初始化默认图片
    if ($img.length && imageUrls[0]) {
      $img.attr('src', imageUrls[0]);
    }

    // 监听点击
    $headers.on('click', function () {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const activeIndex = $headers.index($headers.filter('.active, .eael-active'));
        if (imageUrls[activeIndex]) {
          $img.attr('src', imageUrls[activeIndex]);
        }
      }, 100);
    });
  });
}

// Elementor hook
jQuery(window).on('elementor/frontend/init', function () {
  elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function () {
    setTimeout(initAllAccordionImageSync, 100);
  });
});</script>
